```{r Enriched Heatmap}

# -----------------------------
# Feature specification table
# -----------------------------

  gene = list(

  ),

feature_modes <- names(feature_specs)

Species_Metadata <- list()
Species_Features_gtf <- list()
Species_Canonical_Mappings <- list()
AllFeatureResults <- list()

# -----------------------------
# Helper: derive introns from exons
# -----------------------------
get_introns_from_exons <- function(full.gtf, canonical_map) {

  canonical_col <- intersect(
    c("transcriptId", "transcript_id"),
    names(canonical_map)
  )[1]

  if (is.na(canonical_col)) {
    stop("Could not find canonical transcript column in canonical_map.")
  }

  canonical_ids <- unique(as.character(canonical_map[[canonical_col]]))

  exons <- full.gtf[
    full.gtf$type == "exon" &
      as.character(full.gtf$transcript_id) %in% canonical_ids
  ]

  if (length(exons) == 0) {
    return(GRanges())
  }

  exons_by_tx <- split(exons, exons$transcript_id)

  intron_df_list <- lapply(exons_by_tx, function(tx_exons) {

    tx_exons <- sort(tx_exons)

    if (length(tx_exons) < 2) {
      return(NULL)
    }

    intron_starts <- end(tx_exons)[-length(tx_exons)] + 1
    intron_ends <- start(tx_exons)[-1] - 1

    keep <- intron_starts <= intron_ends

    if (!any(keep)) {
      return(NULL)
    }

    data.frame(
      seqnames = as.character(seqnames(tx_exons)[1]),
      start = as.integer(intron_starts[keep]),
      end = as.integer(intron_ends[keep]),
      strand = as.character(strand(tx_exons)[1]),
      transcript_id = as.character(unique(tx_exons$transcript_id)[1]),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  })

  intron_df_list <- Filter(Negate(is.null), intron_df_list)

  if (length(intron_df_list) == 0) {
    return(GRanges())
  }

  intron_df <- bind_rows(intron_df_list)

  introns <- makeGRangesFromDataFrame(
    intron_df,
    keep.extra.columns = TRUE,
    seqnames.field = "seqnames",
    start.field = "start",
    end.field = "end",
    strand.field = "strand",
    ignore.strand = FALSE
  )

  GenomicRanges::reduce(introns, ignore.strand = FALSE)
}

# -----------------------------
# Helper function
# -----------------------------
get_feature_ranges <- function(
  full.gtf,
  canonical_map = NULL,
  feature_mode,
  feature_spec
) {

  if (isTRUE(feature_spec$derive_introns)) {
    return(get_introns_from_exons(full.gtf, canonical_map))
  }

  gtf_types <- tolower(as.character(full.gtf$type))
  wanted_types <- tolower(feature_spec$types)

  feat <- full.gtf[gtf_types %in% wanted_types]

  if (isTRUE(feature_spec$transcript_linked)) {

    canonical_col <- intersect(
      c("transcriptId", "transcript_id"),
      names(canonical_map)
    )[1]

    if (!is.na(canonical_col) &&
        "transcript_id" %in% names(mcols(feat))) {

      canonical_ids <- unique(
        as.character(canonical_map[[canonical_col]])
      )

      feat <- feat[
        as.character(feat$transcript_id) %in% canonical_ids
      ]
    }
  }

  if (length(feat) == 0) {
    return(GRanges())
  }

  GenomicRanges::reduce(feat, ignore.strand = TRUE)
}

# -----------------------------
# Cache species metadata
# -----------------------------
for (element_name in names(Reduced_Variants)) {

  build <- str_split(
    element_name,
    "_",
    simplify = TRUE
  )[, 5]

  species <- str_split(
    element_name,
    "_",
    simplify = TRUE
  )[, 4] %>%
    str_replace("^(.)(.*)$", "\\1_\\2")

  gtf_path <- paste0(
    "/home/ocdm0351/.conda/envs/snpEff/share/snpeff-5.2-2/data/",
    species,
    "/",
    build,
    "/genes.gtf"
  )

  canonical_path <- paste0(
    "/home/ocdm0351/DPhil/R_Data/Canonical_Transcripts_",
    species,
    "_",
    build,
    "_snpEffSift.tsv"
  )

  full.gtf <- rtracklayer::import(gtf_path)

  canonical_map <- read_tsv(
    canonical_path,
    show_col_types = FALSE
  )

  Species_Metadata[[element_name]] <- list(
    element = Reduced_Variants[[element_name]],
    build = build,
    species = species,
    full.gtf = full.gtf,
    canonical_map = canonical_map
  )
}

# -----------------------------
# Main feature loop
# -----------------------------
for (feature_mode in feature_modes) {

  message("Running feature mode: ", feature_mode)

  feature_spec <- feature_specs[[feature_mode]]

  feature_label <- feature_spec$label

  extend_value <- feature_spec$extend_value
  window <- feature_spec$window
  target_ratio_value <- feature_spec$target_ratio_value

  MutationDensityData <- list()

  for (element_name in names(Species_Metadata)) {

    meta <- Species_Metadata[[element_name]]

    element <- meta$element
    species <- meta$species

    feature_ranges <- get_feature_ranges(
      full.gtf = meta$full.gtf,
      canonical_map = meta$canonical_map,
      feature_mode = feature_mode,
      feature_spec = feature_spec
    )

    if (length(feature_ranges) == 0) {
      next
    }

    variant_ranges <- makeGRangesFromDataFrame(
      element,
      keep.extra.columns = TRUE,
      ignore.strand = TRUE,
      seqnames.field = "CHROM",
      start.field = "POS",
      end.field = "POS"
    )

    variant_ranges <- coverage(variant_ranges)
    variant_ranges <- as(variant_ranges, "GRanges")
    variant_ranges <- variant_ranges[variant_ranges$score > 0]

    body_variants <- normalizeToMatrix(
      variant_ranges,
      feature_ranges,
      extend = extend_value,
      mean_mode = "absolute",
      w = window,
      target_ratio = target_ratio_value,
      smooth = TRUE,
      background = 0
    )

    avg <- colMeans(body_variants)

    se <- apply(
      body_variants,
      2,
      function(x) sd(x) / sqrt(length(x))
    )

    MutationDensities <- data.frame(
      position = seq_along(avg),
      mean_score = avg,
      se = se,
      species = species,
      element_name = element_name,
      feature_mode = feature_mode
    )

    MutationDensityData[[element_name]] <- MutationDensities
  }

  if (length(MutationDensityData) == 0) {
    next
  }

  MutationDensityData <- MutationDensityData[
    !grepl("Hsapiens", names(MutationDensityData))
  ]

  Combined_MutationDensityData <- bind_rows(MutationDensityData)

  Combined_MutationDensityData <-
    Combined_MutationDensityData %>%
    group_by(species) %>%
    mutate(
      norm_factor = mean(mean_score, na.rm = TRUE),
      mean_score = mean_score / norm_factor,
      se = se / norm_factor
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    select(-norm_factor)

  n_bins <- max(Combined_MutationDensityData$position)

  regionLength <- target_ratio_value * n_bins
  lengthEachSide <- (n_bins - regionLength) / 2

  start_bin <- lengthEachSide
  end_bin <- n_bins - lengthEachSide

  # -----------------------------
  # Combined plot
  # -----------------------------
  MultiSpeciesPlot <-
    ggplot(
      Combined_MutationDensityData,
      aes(
        x = position,
        y = mean_score,
        color = species,
        fill = species
      )
    ) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 1.2) +
    geom_ribbon(
      aes(
        ymin = mean_score - se,
        ymax = mean_score + se
      ),
      alpha = 0.2,
      colour = NA
    ) +
    annotate(
      "rect",
      xmin = start_bin,
      xmax = end_bin,
      ymin = -Inf,
      ymax = Inf,
      alpha = 0.05,
      fill = "grey"
    ) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = start_bin, linetype = "dashed") +
    geom_vline(xintercept = end_bin, linetype = "dashed") +
    scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = c(1, start_bin, end_bin, n_bins),
      labels = c(
        paste0("-", extend_value),
        "Start",
        "End",
        paste0("+", extend_value)
      )
    ) +
    labs(
      x = paste0("Position relative to ", feature_label),
      y = "Relative Mutation Enrichment",
      title = paste0(
        "Mutation Enrichment Around ",
        feature_label,
        " (Non-human species)"
      )
    ) +
    theme_minimal()

  out_dir <- file.path(
    "/home/ocdm0351/DPhil/R_Data/Plots/2_GeneBody_Plots",
    feature_mode
  )

  dir.create(
    out_dir,
    recursive = TRUE,
    showWarnings = FALSE
  )

  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(
      out_dir,
      paste0(
        "MultiSpecies_",
        feature_mode,
        "_Enrichment.png"
      )
    ),
    plot = MultiSpeciesPlot,
    width = 25,
    height = 15,
    units = "cm",
    dpi = 1000,
    bg = "transparent"
  )

  # -----------------------------
  # Individual species plots
  # -----------------------------
  SpeciesPlots <- list()

  for (sp in unique(Combined_MutationDensityData$species)) {

    sp_data <- Combined_MutationDensityData %>%
      filter(species == sp)

    sp_plot <-
      ggplot(
        sp_data,
        aes(
          x = position,
          y = mean_score
        )
      ) +
      geom_line(
        linewidth = 1.2,
        color = "#66ff00"
      ) +
      geom_ribbon(
        aes(
          ymin = mean_score - se,
          ymax = mean_score + se
        ),
        fill = "orange",
        alpha = 0.7
      ) +
      annotate(
        "rect",
        xmin = start_bin,
        xmax = end_bin,
        ymin = -Inf,
        ymax = Inf,
        alpha = 0.05,
        fill = "grey"
      ) +
      geom_vline(
        xintercept = start_bin,
        linetype = "dashed"
      ) +
      geom_vline(
        xintercept = end_bin,
        linetype = "dashed"
      ) +
      scale_x_continuous(
        breaks = c(1, start_bin, end_bin, n_bins),
        labels = c(
          paste0("-", extend_value),
          "Start",
          "End",
          paste0("+", extend_value)
        )
      ) +
      labs(
        x = paste0("Position relative to ", feature_label),
        y = "Relative Mutation Enrichment",
        title = paste0(
          sp,
          "\nMutation Enrichment Around ",
          feature_label
        )
      ) +
      theme_minimal() +
      theme(
        aspect.ratio = 1
      )

    SpeciesPlots[[sp]] <- sp_plot

    ggsave(
      filename = file.path(
        out_dir,
        paste0(
          sp,
          "_",
          feature_mode,
          "_Enrichment.png"
        )
      ),
      plot = sp_plot,
      width = 15,
      height = 15,
      units = "cm",
      dpi = 1000,
      bg = "transparent"
    )
  }

  AllFeatureResults[[feature_mode]] <- list(
    combined_data = Combined_MutationDensityData,
    plot = MultiSpeciesPlot,
    species_plots = SpeciesPlots
  )
}
```
